broker.name: EBC Financial Group
broker.tagline: Its site names 6 regulators, including FCA, CIMA, and ASIC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: The EBC Financial Group pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard and Professional. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4 and MetaTrader 5. The site names these regulators: FCA, CIMA, ASIC, FSCA, FSC (Mauritius), and AOFA (Anjouan). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. A minimum deposit figure on the site is 50 USD. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: An official EBC article updated 25 June 2026 says both Standard and Professional accounts require a $50 minimum deposit, and that deposits arrive as a US dollar balance. The trading-account product page does not state a minimum. EBC says it does not charge a deposit fee, and that a payment provider may.

other_fees.label: Deposit fee
other_fees.note: Article updated 25 June 2026. Payment provider may charge. Funding methods named there: local bank transfer, international wire, credit or debit card, USDT, USDC, Neteller, Skrill.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, trading-account page, forex product page, and the 25 June 2026 article loaded. Homepage names FCA, CIMA, ASIC, and FSCA. The FSCA number 51541, Mauritius FSC number, and Anjouan licence are in the forex page footer, not in the homepage licence cards. Homepage FSCA card names the entity but not the number. London is labelled Business Address, not headquarters. The article says offices in London, Tokyo, Sydney, Singapore, and Hong Kong, and says client funds are in a segregated account at Barclays with firm-level Lloyd's of London insurance. A search snippet of another EBC article mentioned lower per-method funding minimums. That page was not fetched, so those figures are not used. No founding year was found.
